sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of the first-sale doctrine. It asks if copyright holders can block the resale of lawfully made foreign copies.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: The importer wants to resell foreign-made books without permission.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: The importer argues that the first-sale doctrine applies to all lawfully made copies.
The publisher argues that the statute only covers copies made under U.S. law.
